integrity: Every occurrence of the deficit parameter in the source's Section 4 proof was rechecked. A standard-library decimal replay verifies the scaled numerical margins; the infinite conclusion follows from the source lemmas plus the explicit inequalities proved in RESULT.md.
scientific_limitations: The improved constant is extracted from the displayed constants in Section 4 of the source and is not claimed optimal. It depends on the source's auxiliary lemmas and keeps the very large threshold \(N\ge e^{200000}\). It remains far below the conjectural optimal finite deficit.
title: A larger explicit finite deficit in Erdős Problem 786 from the published proof constants
